links.comparator_used: Original model applied to the external cohort without updating (split-half validation of the updated model)
links.outcome: External discrimination (AUC) for carotid plaque detection after model updating
links.effect: External AUC 0.666 with marked miscalibration; updating left discrimination unchanged; at 85% sensitivity, specificity was 33.4%
links.quote: External discrimination was moderate and did not improve after recalibration, indicating limited transportability.

design_hint: local validation and recalibration before deployment
